entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Step over bug is back (.NET 9) #121478
  • [API Proposal]: Array.Create<T> with default value and factory function #121477
  • Simplify codegen for tuple swapping of collection elements #121476
  • StackOverflowException in Generic Host CreateApplicationBuilder(args) when running dotnet from Windows on WSL filesystem #121475
  • WASM AOT: condition `<disabled>' not met #121472
  • Polymorphic deserialization of object #121470

Closed

  • [New Feature Request] appsettings.json should have syntax support to enable usage of placeholders for Environment Variables (or any other setting from same config) #46475
  • Suggestion about exceptions #51863
  • [RuntimeAsync] Test failure in NonDisposedSocket_SafeHandlesCollected with runtime async enabled. #121459
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove unsafe from DateTimeRawInfo #121479
    area-System.Runtime, reduce-unsafe
  • Fix EventPipe global keyword/level filter recomputation on session close #121473

Merged

  • Remove redundant #endif/#if #121474
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [RuntimeAsync] Do not hold to the last used Continuation in the runtime async tasks. #121460
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async

Updated

  • Introduce a new internal EventSourceGenerator and use it for all ES implementations #121180
    area-System.Diagnostics.Tracing
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2834844 #121062
    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • Catch exception in SerialStream constructor if DTR or RTS is not available (Windows) #121468
    community-contribution, area-System.IO.Ports
  • Emit IL for AsyncResumptionStub #121456
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Convert build-runtime.cmd to PowerShell #121469
  • Implement bit manipulation API for BFloat16 #120602
    area-System.Numerics, new-api-needs-documentation, community-contribution
  • [RuntimeAsync] Enable runtime async in Libraries partition #119432
    area-VM-coreclr, linkable-framework, runtime-async
